title: Chapter X – Your Test Title
instructions: Answer all questions. Calculators are not permitted.

questions.text: Which of the following is **not** a function of an operating system?
questions.explanation: Compiling is done by a translator (compiler), which is software the OS may run — but it is not a function of the OS itself.

questions.text: A system has 4 processes and 3 processors. A perfect scheduler could run how many processes at the same moment?
questions.explanation: One process per processor — 3 in parallel, the fourth waits in the ready queue.

questions.text: State **two** differences between a compiler and an interpreter.

answer.text: A compiler translates the whole program at once and produces an executable; an interpreter translates and executes line by line.
A compiled program runs faster (no translation at run time); an interpreted program stops at the first error it reaches.

questions.explanation: Also valid: the compiler reports all syntax errors after compilation; an interpreter needs the source code and interpreter present at run time.

questions.text: Complete the table for **X = A AND (NOT B)**.
questions.explanation: X is 1 only when A is 1 and B is 0.
